description: This Java class implements a command strategy for creating a loan charge by external ID within a batch processing context. It interprets the request, extracts parameters like the loan external ID from the URL, and invokes the LoanChargesApiResource to perform the charge creation.

classes.name: CreateChargeByLoanExternalIdCommandStrategy
classes.description: A command strategy component that creates a loan charge via API using a loan external ID, processing batch requests and mapping responses accordingly.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command by parsing the request URL to extract the external ID, invoking the LoanChargesApiResource to create a charge, and forming the batch response with status and body.
